title: Classroom Words
introduction: Learn about classroom words through simple examples and practice.
definition: Classroom words name things we use when learning.
rules: Point to an object and say its name.

vocabulary.description: A tool for writing or drawing.

examples.question: What do you read: a book or a chair?
steps: Read or listen to the question. Think about what you have learnt.

exercises.question: What do you read: a book or a chair?
What do you sit on: a chair or a pencil?
What do you write with: a pencil or a bag?

summary: Classroom words name things we use when learning.
